title: A logic flaw in the BMC IPMI implementation may allow an attacker to send specially crafted RAKP+ messages and…
description: A logic flaw in the Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) IPMI implementation allows an attacker with limited privileges to send specially crafted RAKP+ messages and escalate their account to administrator privileges. This vulnerability can lead to full control over the BMC, impacting confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
